Ticket:
Patient portal secure message routing is completely broken

I am at my wit's end trying to manage the sheer volume of portal messages coming in from patients every morning. The current routing rules seem completely broken because messages from pediatric patients are landing in our cardiology queue, and non-urgent appointment requests are going straight to the nursing staff. We have tried re-tagging the department filters three times this week, but the inbox is still a complete mess. Please look into our account settings and fix how these messages are distributed before a critical message gets missed.
